title: DNA Isolation from Formalin-Fixed, Paraffin-Embedded Material
author: Hendrik F HFvE Van Essen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zjwf4pe

steps.title: Cut tissue sections
steps.instruction: Cut one 3 µm section and 2–3 (or more if needed) 10 µm sections from the FFPE block, depending on tumour area.

steps.title: Mount and dry sections
steps.instruction: Mount all sections on slides coated with 0.1 % BSA and dry overnight at 37 °C (maximum storage time one week).

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides
steps.instruction: Place slides in xylene for 7 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: Rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Pass slides sequentially through 100 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 70 % ethanol, and distilled water.

steps.title: Rinse with tap water
steps.instruction: Wash slides with running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Eosin stain
steps.instruction: Stain slides with eosin for 2 min.

steps.title: Quick water rinse
steps.instruction: Wash slides quickly in water.

steps.title: Dehydrate slides
steps.instruction: Pass slides sequentially through 70 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 100 % ethanol, and finally xylene.

steps.title: Mount coverslip
steps.instruction: Remove slides from xylene and mount a coverslip using DePex.

steps.title: Pathologist review
steps.instruction: Allow the 3 µm H&E slide to be examined by a pathologist; mark tumour area and tumour percentage.

steps.title: Haematoxylin stain (first)
steps.instruction: Stain slides with haematoxylin for 2 min (if solution is not fresh, extend up to a maximum of 4 min).

steps.title: Second deparaffinization
steps.instruction: Place slides in xylene for 7 min, repeat three times.

steps.title: Second rehydration
steps.instruction: Pass slides sequentially through 100 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 70 % ethanol, and water.

steps.title: Haematoxylin stain (second)
steps.instruction: Stain slides with haematoxylin for 1–2 min (if solution is not fresh, extend up to a maximum of 3 min).

steps.title: Rinse with tap water
steps.instruction: Wash slides with running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Distilled water rinse
steps.instruction: Place slides in distilled water.

steps.title: Microdissect tissue
steps.instruction: While still slightly wet, dissect the tissue from the slides with a scalpel or needle.

steps.title: Collect dissected tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer the dissected material into a clean Safelock Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard liquid
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at full speed for 5 min, then discard the water layer.

steps.title: Mix by inversion
steps.instruction: Shake and invert the sample (do not vortex).

steps.title: Add ATL buffer
steps.instruction: Add 160 µl ATL buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19076) to the tube.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 40 µl Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #EO0491).

steps.title: Vortex to mix tissue
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample for 15 s to ensure all tissue is suspended in liquid.

steps.title: Overnight Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube overnight (≈16 h) at 56 °C in a heat‑block or water bath, vortexing regularly; check that tissue is fully digested.

steps.title: Vortex and spin
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples and spin down briefly.

steps.title: High‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 98 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Spin after heating
steps.instruction: Spin at 16 600 rcf for 1 min.

steps.title: Add AL buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl AL buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19076) and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl 100 % ethanol and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Spin before column
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at full speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 µl of lysate to a QIAamp MinElute column.

steps.title: First column spin
steps.instruction: Spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min; discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Place column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Place the QIA column in a clean 2 ml collection tube, ensuring the column tip is free of droplets.

steps.title: Add AW1 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl AW1 buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19081) to the column.

steps.title: Second column spin
steps.instruction: Spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min and transfer the column to a new tube.

steps.title: Add AW2 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl AW2 buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19072) to the column.

steps.title: Third column spin
steps.instruction: Spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min and transfer the column to a new tube.

steps.title: Dry membrane
steps.instruction: Spin at full speed for 3 min to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Transfer column to labeled tube
steps.instruction: Place the QIA column in a properly labeled Eppendorf tube and discard the collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 20–50 µl AE buffer (Qiagen Catalog #19077) depending on sample size, incubate 5 min at 20 °C (room temperature).

steps.title: Final spin
steps.instruction: Spin at full speed for 3 min.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the column, close the Eppendorf tube and store the purified DNA at 4 °C.
